messages:
oncall-bot: ALERT: Dedicated pool 'juno-dedicated-pool' (tenant: JunoFinance) - GPU node eviction detected. 3/12 workers down, 99th-p90 latency spike. Pager: alex.
oncall-bot: link: https://monitoring.redwood.internal/incident/1919001111
oncall-bot: auto-created incident channel: #incident-juno-dedpool-1919001111

alex: Ack. I'm on it. Checking pool status and routing rules.

alex: @infra-bot can you pull the node status and eviction reason? Need cloud event id and whether this was spot reclaim or HW fault.

infra-bot: Node details: 
- node: g4dn-24-juno-07
- event: SPOT_TERMINATION_NOTICE (90s)
- eviction_time: expected in 75s
- running_tasks: 2 (tenant: JunoFinance)
- last_telemetry: GPU temp normal, NVLINK ok

alex: Ok this is a spot reclaim. We need to drain the node gracefully. Initiating drain + migrate KV cache for active sessions.

alex: runbook step1: set node to cordon -> `rd infra node cordon g4dn-24-juno-07`
```
rd infra node cordon g4dn-24-juno-07
```

alex: step2: migrate sessions: `rd runtime migrate --node g4dn-24-juno-07 --tenant JunoFinance`

jeanne: I'm taking handoff from alex. Oncall rotation change in 8m. Alex pls leave notes in thread.

alex: Handoff note: cordon issued, migrate started, 1 active long-lived chat session still streaming (session-id: s-08a3). If migration fails we'll fallback to canary model v-small to keep latency but reduce compute. Owner: jeanne.

jeanne: Received. Starting active session drain watch. @maria-cs can you message JunoFinance ops to set expectations? We might need to fail over to their reserved capacity if migration doesn't finish.

maria-cs: Messaging now. Telling them expected interruption window ~2m, we will keep them updated. Also asking whether they have any strict SLA runbooks we should follow before failover.

ops: Noted - near-term mitigation: enable tenant fallback-routing to reserved-pool-rho: `rd router set-route --tenant JunoFinance --fallback reserved-pool-rho --priority 10`

jeanne: Doing fallback-route with gradual drain (no abrupt cut). Apply TTL 60s to new connections so ongoing streams can finish.
```
rd router set-route --tenant JunoFinance --fallback reserved-pool-rho --ttl 60
```

infra-bot: Migration progress: 1/2 sessions migrated, KV cache transfer 72% complete, ETA 25s.

jeanne: KV cache transfer stalled at 72% for 15s. Trying manual requeue.

ryan: I see transient S3 latency errors during checkpoint push which can stall KV transfer. I'm spinning up a helper job to proxy and push checkpoints directly to reserved-pool NFS.

lisa: @jeanne if migration fails, do we want to enable model variant degrade? We can switch JunoFinance inference model to quantized-8bit to reduce memory and let remaining workers handle load.

jeanne: Yes prepare degrade plan. Ryan, coordinate helper job to copy checkpoint while I toggle routing. Maria, tell customer we have a fallback plan to keep requests served with slightly lower throughput.

infra-bot: SPOT_TERMINATION_NOTICE now at 0s - node is being reclaimed. Draining forced.

jeanne: Forced drain happening. One session interrupted (s-08a3). Recording incident impact: single streaming session cut, ~45s disruption. We'll open a post-incident note.

maria-cs: JunoFinance replied: "We saw a brief streaming drop, but overall unaffected. Please confirm if any data was lost." Asking for confirmation on message delivery semantics.

jeanne: Confirming: no inference outputs lost on server side; session was interrupted during streaming chunk boundary. We'll replay missing partials using dedup token id if needed. Action: ops to run recovery replay for s-08a3.

ops: Recovery in progress: replaying last 2 chunks from checkpoint id ck-7f12 -> pushing to JunoFinance ingestion endpoint.

infra-bot: Replacement node request submitted to cloud. New node: g4dn-24-juno-12 provisioning. ETA 3m.

jeanne: After replacement up, we'll re-balance pool and remove fallback-route. Keep fallback in place until 3 consecutive 5m windows of stable latency.

alex: Back from rotation, noted. Jeannie — thanks for the handoff. Please paste final timeline & customer impact in #postmortems when done.

jeanne: Will do. Draft timeline: 1919001111 alert -> cordon -> migration -> spot reclaim -> forced drain -> 1 session interruption (~45s) -> helper job replay -> new node provisioning -> traffic rebalanced -> fallback route removed.

maria-cs: JunoFinance confirmed receipt of replayed chunks and reports "service stable". They asked for RCA and whether we can reduce spot usage on their tenant. I'll collect customer ask and schedule follow-up.

jeanne: Action items: (1) ops/infra to verify KV checkpoint reliability under S3 hiccups (Ryan + infra) (2) platform: evaluate possibility to mark high-SLA tenants as spot-protected (alex + infra) (3) cs: follow up with JunoFinance re: reserved capacity option (maria-cs).

ryan: Filing bug: `PLT-4332` - KV checkpoint retry behavior during S3 transient errors.

jeanne: Closing incident channel in 30m if stable. Logging to incident tracker with severity: P2, customer-impact: brief streaming interruption, nodes replaced: 1, mitigations used: fallback routing + checkpoint replay.

oncall-bot: Incident 1919001111 marked resolved by jeanne at 1919001560.
